preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10,000.
Each test case contains two integers x and y, each between 1 and 100.

postconditions.description: The first output integer is a strictly positive integer.
The second output integer is a strictly positive integer.
The output is [0, 0] if it is impossible to choose a pair of positive integers a and b to make x equal to y.
